name: sebaro-website-astro
description: Startvorlage: statische Website mit Astro und sebaro (Beispielseite).

scripts.sebaro:verify: node public/sebaro/checks/verify-export.mjs public/sebaro --strict && python3 public/sebaro/product/product_kit.py check sebaro.product.json --copy public/sebaro --out sebaro-product
scripts.sebaro:product: python3 public/sebaro/product/product_kit.py build sebaro.product.json --copy public/sebaro --out sebaro-product --render
scripts.build: node scripts/site-root.mjs && node scripts/og.mjs && astro build --mode pages --outDir build/pages && node scripts/cut.mjs && astro build && node scripts/budgets.mjs
